senses.sense_definition: To question someone or a group after an event or project to review the experience and learn from results

examples.text: The manager gathered the team to <w>debrief</w> the results of the recent marketing campaign.
We need to schedule a meeting to <w>debrief</w> the team after the conference ends.

senses.sense_definition: To question someone thoroughly after a mission or operation in order to gather intelligence and information

examples.text: Officers gathered to <w>debrief</w> the pilots immediately after their return from the mission.
The intelligence agent was carefully <w>debriefed</w> upon arriving back at headquarters.

senses.sense_definition: To explain the true nature and outcomes of an experiment to participants after it concludes

examples.text: Ethical guidelines require researchers to fully <w>debrief</w> participants after psychological studies.
She took twenty minutes to <w>debrief</w> the students about the deceptive elements used during the test.
